---

<div className="real-function-page">

```lua
cache.invalidate(instance: Instance)
```

## Argümanlar

<ParamField path={"instance"} type={"Instance"} required>
Cachelenen registry girdisi kaldirilacak Instance.
</ParamField>

## Örnek

Bir Instance degerini Real cache icinden kaldir ve cache girdisinin hala var olup olmadigini kontrol et.

```lua
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

cache.invalidate(Players)

print(cache.iscached(Players))
```
